Notes_and_Tips: Avoid mutton as per your preference.
Try to eat your meals at the same time every day to help support stable blood sugar levels.
When biryani or special rice dishes are prepared at home, serve yourself a smaller portion of rice and fill the rest of your plate with protein and vegetables.
Aim for 15–20 minutes of morning sunlight daily. Regular morning sunlight can help support your sleep cycle, energy levels and overall wellbeing.
Continue practicing yoga regularly and include a 30-minute walk after lunch or dinner whenever possible to support blood sugar management.
Drink at least 2.5–3 litres of water daily and include green leafy vegetables regularly.
